changes.holm_validity: A primary rank enters Holm with its real rank p ONLY if its primary read is VALID: no shared VOID (liveness-arm collapse, KO_IDENT != KO, KO_IDENT sidecar missing), no primary VOID (CAND collapse, primary family norm/rank/hooks, CAPOP replay, BASE_CAND hooks), manipulation and instrument gates pass, and the CAND recovery is status ok with a CI. Any other rank (absent, NOT ANALYZABLE, VOID, gate-failed, CANNOT ANSWER) enters as p=1 with m=2, and every other rank of that codeword becomes 'INCOMPLETE FAMILY' (never PASS). Secondary family: same rule, using shared + secondary VOIDs, the gates, and the CWONLY secondary recovery. p2b_analyze._valid_primary/_valid_secondary/finalize; regression tests (VOID r1 p=1/82 + r4 p=0.03 -> r4 INCOMPLETE with Holm p 0.06; gate-failed / CANNOT ANSWER / shared-VOID rank -> INCOMPLETE; shared VOID makes the secondary INCOMPLETE).
changes.addon_voids: Add-on (MEANBIAS / raw-norm) path: every add-on arm is hook-checked; KO_MEANBIAS, KO_CWMEANBIAS and the raw-norm arms are collapse-screened (median option mass < 0.05 => listed in addon.void). BASE_MEANBIAS collapse is reported as damage (addon.BASE_MEANBIAS_collapsed), not a VOID.
changes.input_conditional_wording: 'Input-conditional' (or semantic/operator-specific) wording requires, on VALIDATION, CAND beats BOTH KO_MEANBIAS and KO_CWMEANBIAS with domain-bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0 (CAND_minus_MEANBIAS and CAND_minus_CWMEANBIAS), AND neither MEANBIAS arm is VOID/collapsed. If either comparator collapsed or is VOID, the wording is SUSPENDED (cannot be earned on that split). Reported as addon.input_conditional_wording_eligible_on_this_split (descriptive; not a preregistered pass). The amendment-3 rule for CWONLY vs KO_CWMEANBIAS stands for any CWONLY wording.
changes.meanbias_overshoot_note: KO_MEANBIAS adds the FULL-norm TRAIN-mean gap at EVERY position of 26 modules (total norm basket 46.2, button 53.1 per position), whereas the gap was measured only at the codeword row; at other positions it may overshoot and damage the readout. Its option mass (addon.median_option_mass) and clean-prompt damage (BASE_MEANBIAS_minus_BASE_y, BASE_MEANBIAS option mass) are always reported next to it, and a collapsed KO_MEANBIAS suspends the input-conditional wording rather than counting as a CAND win.
